data.value: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?

Kestrel Analytics is considering a proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office. The landlord has offered six months rent-free as an incentive. The landlord's option to accept the lease expires next Friday (2026-08-14). The CEO must decide to sign or walk away before that deadline.
